description: Land Acquisition - Divest an allotment in Divulapitiya, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, specifically the divestment of previously acquired land allotments back from the State. It references the Land Acquisition Act, describes specific land parcels with detailed boundaries and measurements, and involves property rights and land administration. The mention of a minister's name is incidental to the land-related legal process rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
